name: SQLAlchemy raw-query injection class (CWE-89)
description: Patterns that match SQL-injection-class weaknesses reported by scanners in ORMs that allow raw query execution without parameter binding.
rationale: SQL injection defeats NIST SI-10 (input validation) and AC-4 (information flow enforcement). PCI DSS 6.2.4 requires secure coding practices addressing injection. OWASP ASVS 5.3.4/5.3.5 require parameterised queries or prepared statements.
